entries.german:
Boppo [II.] Graf von Wertheim übergibt mit Zustimmung seiner Ehefrau Mechthild und seiner Söhne zu seinem und ihrem Seelenheil dem Deutschen Hause die Pfarrei zu Eschenbach. - Zeugen: Graf Rupert von Castele, Siboto von Ludin, Cunrad von Entsee, Arnold von Thirbach, Hartmann von Schalkevelt, Albert von Halleberc, Conradus von Vssinheim, Heinrich von Totinbrunn, Wernher (Priester).

Enthält-/Darin-Vermerke: Transkription: Ut in nostris gesta temporibus immota permaneant et in suis stabiliter inclusa terminis ilibata semper et integre perseverent, literarum debent custodie mancipari. Hinc est, quod tam ad presentium quam ad futurorum notitiam volo pervenire, quod ego Boppo comes de Wertheim habito concilio et licentia uxoris mee Mechthildis puerorumque meorum favore pro remedio anime mee et parentum meorum nec non eorum, qui mecum in sempiterna dote sunt participes, parochiam in Eschenbach com omnibus pertinentiis suis domui Teutonicorum in honorem s. Dei genitricis Mairie contuli liberam et ab omni successorum meorum proprietate dissolutam. Ut ergo hec donatio in perpetuum vigeat et valeat, litteris meis et sigili mei munimine corroboravi. Testes hujus facti sunt: comes Rupertus de Castelle, Siboto de Ludin, Conradus de Entsee, Arnoldus de Thirbach, Hartmundus de Schalkefelt, Albertus de Halleberc, Conradus de Ussinheim, Heinrich de Tottenbrunn, Wernherus sacerdos.
entries.english: Boppo [II], Count of Wertheim, with the consent of his wife Mechthild and his sons, grants the parish of Eschenbach to the Teutonic Order for the salvation of his soul and theirs. Witnesses: Count Rupert von Castele, Siboto von Lauda, Cunrad von Entsee, Arnold von Thirbach, Hartmann von Schalkevelt, Albert von Halleberc, Konrad von Uissigheim, Heinrich von Totinbrunn, and Wernher, priest. Enclosures/contents: Transcription: “So that the deeds done in our times may remain undisturbed and be preserved within their bounds, always continuing intact and whole, they ought to be entrusted to the keeping of documents. Therefore I wish it to be known both to those now living and to those to come that I, Boppo, Count of Wertheim, with the counsel and permission of my wife Mechthild and the favor of my children, for the salvation of my soul and of my parents, as well as of those who share with me in an everlasting inheritance, have granted the parish of Eschenbach, with all its appurtenances, to the Teutonic House in honor of the holy Mother of God Mary, free and released from all property claims of my successors. So that this donation may endure and remain valid forever, I have confirmed it by my charter and the protection of my seal. Witnesses to this act are Count Rupertus de Castelle, Siboto von Lauda, Conradus de Entsee, Arnoldus de Thirbach, Hartmundus de Schalkefelt, Albertus de Halleberc, Konrad von Uissigheim, Heinrich de Tottenbrunn, and Wernherus, priest.”
